scope: An ideal geometric and listening experiment after Ptolemy, Harmonics II.2. Uniform strings share the same full-length pitch; a zero-width bridge sets their sounding lengths. Tension, material, bridge height and coupling are held outside this model. Sine tones, absolute reference pitch and the four-string retuning exercise are modern choices. This is not a reconstruction or a measurement of an ancient instrument.
